caqh_proview.name: CAQH ProView Profile
caqh_proview.description: Universal credentialing data repository used by all five payers. Must be completed and attested BEFORE initiating any payer application.

tasks.name: Create CAQH ProView account
tasks.description: Register at proview.caqh.org with NPI number

tasks.name: Complete personal information section
tasks.description: Legal name, DOB, SSN, contact information, practice addresses

tasks.name: Upload professional documents
tasks.description: State license(s), DEA certificate, malpractice COI, board certifications, W-9

tasks.name: Complete work history
tasks.description: 5-year work history with all gaps explained (gap threshold varies by payer: >30 days for Aetna, >6 months for Cigna/UHC)

tasks.name: Enter Professional IDs
tasks.description: NPI, DEA, state license numbers, Medicare PTAN (if applicable), Medicaid ID

tasks.name: Authorize payer data sharing
tasks.description: Grant data access to each payer. CRITICAL: Each payer/subsidiary requires separate authorization

tasks.name: Attest profile
tasks.description: Review all information for accuracy and electronically attest. Profile must remain attested throughout enrollment.

npi.name: National Provider Identifier (NPI)
npi.description: Obtain Type 1 (individual) NPI from NPPES if not already assigned

medicare_enrollment.name: Medicare Part B Enrollment (LPC/MFT)
medicare_enrollment.description: As of January 1, 2024, LPCs and MFTs must enroll in Original Medicare via PECOS/CMS-855I and obtain a PTAN before any MA plan credentialing.

requirements.experience: 2 years / 3,000 hours post-master's supervised clinical experience

validity_rules.cigna_bh: Must be 60+ days from expiration at application
validity_rules.humana: Must be valid 45+ days into the future
validity_rules.optum: Must be independent licensure — no provisional or supervisory-dependent

validity_rules.humana: Must be valid 45+ days into the future
Must be valid 45+ days into the future

universal.name: W-9 Form
universal.notes: UHC: Legal name and TIN must match IRS records exactly

universal.name: Board Certification
universal.notes: Required for physicians; status verified for all provider types

payer_specific.name: Medicare PTAN/CCN
payer_specific.notes: Critical for Humana MA participation. Enter in CAQH Professional IDs section.

payer_specific.name: Collaborative Practice Agreement
payer_specific.notes: Required in states that mandate collaborative agreements

payer_specific.name: Hospital Privilege Letters
payer_specific.notes: If applicable / if admitting privileges held

steps.name: Submit Request for Participation
steps.description: Complete the online Request for Participation form on Aetna's provider enrollment page.
warnings: Use the MEDICAL form — not the BH form. Using the wrong form is a common costly error.

steps.name: Network Need Assessment
steps.description: Aetna evaluates geographic need for your specialty. This determines whether the panel is open or closed in your area.
steps.outcome_if_denied: Denial letter received. Provider can reapply later or request reconsideration.

steps.name: Receive & Review Provider Participation Agreement
steps.description: If panel is open, Aetna Network Manager sends Provider Participation Agreement via email.
warnings: Request detailed fee schedules before signing. Multiple sources report Aetna sometimes sends contracts without clear reimbursement details.

steps.name: Sign and Return Contract
steps.description: Review fee schedule, sign Provider Participation Agreement, and return to Aetna.

steps.name: Primary Source Verification (Credentialing)
steps.description: Aetna's CVO (3Won/ProVault) verifies licensure, DEA, education, board certification, malpractice history, NPDB, OIG/SAM exclusions, and work history.

steps.name: Credentialing Committee Review
steps.description: Credentialing committee reviews complete file and communicates decision in writing.

steps.name: Network Effective Date Confirmed
steps.description: Provider receives approval letter with network effective date. Provider is now live in Aetna network.

behavioral_health.label: Aetna Behavioral Health Provider Enrollment
critical_notes: Aetna frequently delegates BH credentialing to third parties (often Optum/UBH), adding complexity.
BH providers MUST use the dedicated Behavioral Health Request for Participation form.
Aetna cut audio-only and asynchronous telehealth coverage in 2024. Live video only.

steps.name: Submit Behavioral Health Request for Participation
steps.description: Complete the dedicated BH application form (different from medical form).
warnings: Do NOT use the general medical enrollment form. BH has its own form.

steps.name: Network Need Assessment (BH)
steps.description: Aetna assesses geographic and specialty need for behavioral health. This step often takes longer for BH than medical.

steps.name: Third-Party Delegation Routing
steps.description: Aetna may route BH credentialing to a delegated entity (often Optum/UBH). Provider may need to interact with both Aetna and the delegated entity.
warnings: This step is unique to Aetna and is the primary reason for extended BH timelines.

steps.name: Receive & Sign BH Participation Agreement
steps.description: Review and sign the behavioral health-specific participation agreement.

steps.name: Primary Source Verification (BH Credentialing)
steps.description: CVO conducts full verification. May be processed by Aetna's CVO or delegated entity.

steps.name: Credentialing Committee Review
steps.description: Committee reviews and issues written decision.

steps.name: Network Effective Date Confirmed
steps.description: Approval letter with effective date issued.

steps.name: Call Cigna Credentialing Line
steps.description: Call 1-800-882-4462, select credentialing option. Representative confirms eligibility and emails application packet.

steps.name: Complete & Submit Application Packet
steps.description: Fill out the application packet received via email and submit with required documents.

steps.name: Primary Source Verification
steps.description: Cigna credentialing team verifies all documentation through primary sources.

steps.name: Credentialing Committee Review
steps.description: Committee composed of community physicians and health plan medical director reviews file.

steps.name: Welcome Letter & Directory Listing
steps.description: Welcome letter issued. Provider directory updated within 10 business days of approval.

behavioral_health.label: Cigna / Evernorth Behavioral Health Enrollment
critical_notes: BH is handled by Evernorth Behavioral Health (separate from Cigna Healthcare).
CAQH must authorize BOTH 'Cigna Healthcare' AND 'Evernorth Behavioral Health'.
Exception states (MD, OH, WA): email BehavioralHCPEnrollment@Evernorth.com instead of using the online form.
BH providers must maintain 24 clinical hours per week.
Licenses and insurance must be at least 60 days from expiration at application.

steps.name: Authorize Evernorth in CAQH
steps.description: In CAQH ProView, authorize BOTH 'Cigna Healthcare' AND 'Evernorth Behavioral Health' for data sharing. This is the #1 missed step.
warnings: Must authorize BOTH entities. Authorizing only 'Cigna Healthcare' will NOT cover BH.

steps.name: Submit Evernorth BH Provider Information Form
steps.description: Complete online form at Evernorth's Salesforce portal. Exception: MD, OH, WA providers email BehavioralHCPEnrollment@Evernorth.com instead.

steps.name: Evernorth Initial Outreach
steps.description: Evernorth contacts provider within 21 business days with next steps or information requests.
warnings: If Evernorth requests additional information, providers have 30 days to respond or the application may be closed.

steps.name: Sign Contract via DocuSign
steps.description: Evernorth sends Individual Agreement via DocuSign for electronic signature. Multiple network types available: Open Access Plus, LocalPlus, PPO, HMO, EAP.

steps.name: Primary Source Verification
steps.description: Evernorth Credentialing Committee conducts verification. If significant discrepancies found, provider contacted within 5 days with 30 days to respond.

steps.name: Credentialing Committee Decision
steps.description: Evernorth Credentialing Committee approves or denies. Appeal process available through separate panel of 3+ uninvolved clinicians.

steps.name: Welcome Letter & Directory Upload
steps.description: Welcome letter issued. Provider directory updated within 10 business days of approval.

uhc.name: UnitedHealthcare

support.label: Chat via Provider Portal (NO phone support)

uhc.bh_routing: All behavioral health credentialing routes to Optum Behavioral Health. See 'optum' payer entry.

steps.name: Create One Healthcare ID
steps.description: Register for a One Healthcare ID at uhcprovider.com. This is the shared SSO across UHC and Optum.

steps.name: Complete Onboard Pro Application
steps.description: Enter legal name, business name, TIN, state, and lines of business. Onboard Pro runs pre-credentialing check and auto-populates from CAQH ProView.

steps.name: Primary Source Verification
steps.description: UHC conducts verification following NCQA standards: OIG, SAM.gov, NPDB, state sanctions databases. Site visits may occur for high-risk specialties.

steps.name: National Credentialing Committee Review
steps.description: Committee reviews and decides within 30 calendar days.

steps.name: Receive Participation Agreement
steps.description: Upon approval, Onboard Pro automatically triggers contracting. Participation Agreement mailed within 5 business days.

steps.name: Sign and Return Agreement
steps.description: Review, sign, and return the Participation Agreement.

steps.name: Network Activation
steps.description: Provider becomes active in UHC network. Status trackable via Onboard Pro real-time dashboard with projected completion dates.

behavioral_health.label: Optum Behavioral Health Provider Enrollment
critical_notes: CAQH must authorize 'United Behavioral Health' (Agency ID 1354) — NOT 'UnitedHealthcare'.
Enrolling in UHC does NOT enroll you in Optum, and vice versa.
After credentialing approval, data loading takes an additional 5–30 business days before provider is live.
Independent licensure required — no provisional or supervisory-dependent licenses.
All UHC/Optum/UBH entities use EDI Payer ID 87726 for BH claims.

steps.name: Authorize UBH in CAQH ProView
steps.description: Authorize 'United Behavioral Health' (Agency ID# 1354) in CAQH data sharing. This is the #1 Optum-specific enrollment error — providers often authorize 'UnitedHealthcare' instead.
warnings: Must authorize 'United Behavioral Health' — NOT 'UnitedHealthcare'. Agency ID: 1354.

steps.name: Create One Healthcare ID
steps.description: Register at providerexpress.com using shared SSO (same as UHC).

steps.name: Submit Network Participation Request Form (NPRF)
steps.description: Complete the NPRF online through Provider Express.

steps.name: Sign Individual Agreement via DocuSign
steps.description: Optum sends Individual Agreement via DocuSign for electronic signature.

steps.name: Primary Source Verification (Verisys)
steps.description: Verisys (NCQA-certified CVO) conducts full verification including licensure, DEA, education, malpractice, NPDB, OIG/SAM, work history, and peer references.

steps.name: Credentialing Committee Review
steps.description: Standing Credentialing Committee (operating under Quality Improvement Committee authority) reviews and decides.

steps.name: Data Loading (Post-Approval)
steps.description: After approval, provider data is loaded into claims systems and directories. This is a known lag unique to Optum.
warnings: Providers are approved but cannot bill or be found in directories until data loading completes. Track via Initial Credentialing Status Toolbar in Provider Express.

steps.name: Live in Network
steps.description: Provider is active in claims systems and provider directories.

other_states.medical: Letter of Interest to regional Humana representative
other_states.behavioral_health: Behavioral Health Provider Inquiry form (Microsoft Forms)

steps.name: Determine Submission Method by State
steps.description: Submission method depends on state. IN/KY/MI/OH/OK/VA/WV use Quickbase online form. All other states submit Letter of Interest to regional representative.

routing_rules.other_states_method: Letter of Interest to regional rep

steps.name: Submit Interest / Application
steps.description: Submit via Quickbase form or Letter of Interest depending on state routing.

steps.name: Assigned Physician Contracting Representative
steps.description: Humana validates request, assigns contracting representative with tracking number, and sends follow-up email with contracting documents.

steps.name: Sign Contracting Documents
steps.description: Review and sign participation agreement sent via email.

steps.name: Primary Source Verification
steps.description: Humana credentialing team verifies documentation, runs NPDB, OIG/SAM, and Medicare sanctions checks.

steps.name: Provider Office Site Evaluation
steps.description: Humana conducts on-site evaluation for PCP and OB-GYN locations. This is unique to Humana among the five payers studied.

steps.name: Credentialing Committee Decision
steps.description: Committee reviews and communicates decision within 60 business days of committee meeting.

steps.name: Network Effective Date + System Updates
steps.description: Network effective date set 30 days after all CAQH documentation is received, with another 30 days for system updates.
warnings: 30 days after CAQH complete + 30 days system updates = up to 60 days post-approval before truly live.

behavioral_health.label: Humana Behavioral Health Provider Enrollment
critical_notes: Humana operates its own BH network through Humana Behavioral Health.
For certain Medicaid products, Humana partners with Carelon Behavioral Health (FL, IL).
Medicare PTAN is critical for MA participation — missing PTAN is the #1 cause of MA denials at Humana.
BH Profiling Form required in addition to standard documents.
Telehealth: audio-only permanently allowed, no geographic restrictions, in-person waived through 12/31/2027.

steps.name: Determine Submission Method by State
steps.description: IN/MI/OH/OK/VA/WV use Quickbase form. All other states use Behavioral Health Provider Inquiry form (Microsoft Forms).

steps.name: Submit BH Application
steps.description: Submit via appropriate channel. Include Behavioral Health Profiling Form.

steps.name: Contracting Representative Assignment
steps.description: Humana validates request and assigns contracting representative.

steps.name: Sign BH Participation Agreement
steps.description: Review and sign behavioral health participation agreement.

steps.name: Primary Source Verification
steps.description: Full credentialing verification including Medicare sanctions review.

steps.name: Credentialing Committee Decision
steps.description: Committee reviews and communicates decision.

steps.name: Network Activation + System Updates
steps.description: Network effective date confirmed. 30 days after CAQH complete + 30 days system updates.

recommended_order.rationale: Fastest BH timelines (60-120 days), structured 21-day outreach commitment
Best status tracking, clear process. Start early to account for 5-30 day data loading lag.
Onboard Pro dashboard provides real-time tracking. Can run parallel with Optum BH.
Critical for Medicare Advantage patient access. Ensure Medicare PTAN is obtained first.
Longest BH timelines (6-12 months). Start early but manage expectations.

interstate_compacts.name: PSYPACT
interstate_compacts.notes: Some payer platforms don't yet recognize PSYPACT for credentialing

interstate_compacts.name: Counseling Compact
interstate_compacts.notes: Will expand multi-state practice for LPCs

changes: Verification timeframes shortened from 180 to 120 days (health plan accreditation)
New 'information integrity' standards replace previous must-pass elements
Annual auditing with 3-6 month follow-up required
